run_training_cli: run the training CLI to train a model on one or multiple GPUs using fairseq arguments
run_training_slurm: run the training script on a SLURM cluster by setting the SLURM_ARGS environment variable
launch_slurm_job: launch a distributed training job on a SLURM cluster with specified nodes and GPUs
review_cli_main: review the cli_main function that parses training arguments and spawns distributed training processes
review_launch_cluster: review the launch_cluster function that builds sbatch and srun commands for SLURM job submission
